build.profile: one 100G port (CMAC + OpenNIC packet adapter), 280-bit Kulisch, four exact banks, no FP32 path
build.source: make u280 (RS-FEC on), post_route_physopt reports of the published bitstream

timing.source: timing_summary.rpt; the RS-FEC-off value from the second published bitstream

lut_by_block.note: Kulisch = striped exact banks (95,308) + final rounding (40,209); receive and control = receiver (5,944) + tile buffer (4,628) + control (3,271); 100G port = CMAC subsystem (9,221) + packet adapter (711); other = the remaining LUTs of the design.

power_w.note: Vectorless estimate, report_power on the routed checkpoint, 25 C ambient.
power_w.source: report_power and report_power -hier on the routed checkpoint

line_rate.note: Verilator, regression run on the release RTL before the bitstream build. DATA and RESULT: rtl-u280-profile, two ranks on one port, 4096 elements, all 24 input/output pairs. Sparse AUTO: rtl-result-wide-target, 64 INT8 lanes per tile with 280-bit exact values at the listed lanes; lanes 16, 32, 63 is the worst tile found by exhaustive search.
line_rate.source: logs of make test SUITE=rtl-u280-profile and SUITE=rtl-result-wide-target
